summary.text: Michele Peña is a Republican member of the Arizona House of Representatives for District 23, according to the Arizona Legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: According to Peña's campaign website, Peña is a lifelong resident of Yuma, the daughter of a mother who immigrated from Mexico and a father who is a Vietnam veteran.
The website says Peña was elected to the Arizona House in 2022 and is running again in 2026.

sources.title: Michele Peña for Arizona State House!
